summary: Frontend E2E testing of V3Cube Pack D Medical Module (Appointment + Transport) on UserHome → /medical/appointment and /medical/transport. All critical flows passed including doctor listing, specialty filter, RDV creation, ambulance type selection, Leaflet map pickup/destination selection via map clicks, fare estimation and transport confirmation, with redirection to /history.
critical_code_review_comments: MedicalTransportPage.js: useEffect resets estimate when pickup/dest/ambulanceType change — correct, prevents stale fare. OK.
MedicalAppointmentPage.js: HTML allows nested <label> with <flex> wrappers — minor a11y nit, not blocking.
Both pages handle empty submit with toast properly and disable submit buttons during async ops — good UX.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 appointment (doctor doc_gp1, tomorrow 14:00, clinic mode) and 1 transport request (ICU, urgent, Paris coordinates ~48.8566,2.34→2.36) via API during E2E tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Medical module fully functional. Appointment flow: 6 doctors, 7 specialties, validation toast on empty submit, success screen + redirect /history. Transport flow: 3 ambulance types (basic/icu/wheelchair), Leaflet map 220px height visible, pickup/dest selectable via map clicks, urgency 3 levels, fare estimation works (ICU 1.93km ≈ 125.88€), confirmation + redirect /history. Both pages have all required data-testid attributes.

appointment_flow.home_buttons: medical-appointment-btn and medical-other-btn both present on /home
appointment_flow.specialty_filter: 7 specialties + 'all'; filtering by Cardiologie reduced list from 6 to 1
appointment_flow.mode_switching: mode-clinic ↔ mode-home works; appointment-address input appears in home mode
